observations: Three photos show stacks of used tires piled under a corrugated-metal roof, roadside/stall setting.
Tires show visible dirt, grime, and worn/scuffed sidewalls; several have faint chalk/paint marks (numbers, arrows) typical of used-tire sorting, not new-stock branding.
No tire brand name, DOT code, or size marking is legible in any photo; sidewalls are too dusty/blurred to read.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI / IKWE ANTHONY' overlays all three images, consistent with a reused stock listing rather than a single item for sale.
Tread patterns vary across the stacks, indicating mixed makes/models/sizes rather than one uniform product.
No photo shows a single tire isolated with full sidewall or tread detail close-up.

identity.kind: used car tires (mixed sizes/brands, bulk stock)

claims.evidence: No brand, country-of-origin marking, or distributor signage/certificate visible in any photo; tires appear used and dirty, not new stock from a named manufacturer.

risks.risk: True size and brand of any given tire (needed for per-unit pricing) is unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of a single tire's sidewall showing brand, size (e.g. 205/55R16) and DOT/date code.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unbranded used tire, lowest tier

risks.risk: Tread depth and remaining life not verifiable from distance/stacked photos.
risks.proof: Close-up of tread with a coin or ruler for depth reference.

risks.risk: Hidden sidewall damage, bulges, repairs, or cracking from age/UV exposure.
risks.proof: Full 360° video of a single tire's sidewall and inner surface.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic/structural risk present, i.e. lowest grade

risks.risk: Claim of 'Belgium' origin could be a generic marketing term not reflecting actual import source.
risks.proof: Photo of import/customs documentation or a tire sidewall showing 'Made in Belgium'.
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverified origin claim, no price premium applied

proof_requests: Close-up photo of one specific tire's sidewall showing brand, size, and DOT code.
Tread depth photo with measuring tool or coin for scale.
Video walk-around of a single tire being sold, not the whole stock pile.
Any documentation supporting 'major distributor' or Belgian origin claim.
response.reason: The listing shows a bulk, mixed stock of used tires with no readable size, brand, or tread-depth detail for any single item, so even a worst-case per-unit price cannot be set without a clear sidewall/tread shot.
